question: According to Table 6 (first layer crystallized at 300 °C), what mean crystal masses were obtained with the second layer heated at 250 °C and at 300 °C?
rendered: According to Table 6, the mean crystal masses obtained with the second layer heated at 250 °C and at 300 °C are 1.646 g and 1.878 g, respectively.
